title: Museo de las Tres Colonias
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Museo de las Tres Colonias provides a living history highlighting Hispanic life, working conditions in the sugar beet industry and community life, most specifically within the Tres Colonias, Buckingham, Andersonville, and Alta Vista, during the Twentieth Century. The adobe home is a great educational tool, interpreting the significance of Hispanic culture and its impact on the Fort Collins community.
